submission.justification: Mixture-G1 at a 2 mm gap gave the best simulated time resolution of all candidates and gaps tested: 0.907 ns (100k events). The gap scan for G1 was 1.008 ns at 1 mm, 0.907 ns at 2 mm and 1.012 ns at 3 mm, so 2 mm is the optimum. The best G3 point (1.335 ns at 2 mm) and the best G2 point (2.082 ns at 2 mm) are both clearly worse. The 2025 summary at 2 mm gave the same ranking (G1 0.9 ns, G3 1.3 ns, G2 2.0 ns). Gap is within the 1–3 mm range. HV (up to 12 kV) is compatible with all mixtures, and the 90% recirculation plan applies to every mixture. CAVEAT: no project document states the laboratory's environmental and safety policy, so I could not verify that G1 complies. G1 is a standard fluorinated mixture, and fluorinated gases are often subject to environmental (GWP/F-gas) restrictions. Compliance must be confirmed by EHS before G1 is procured. If G1 is not permitted, the fallback is Mixture-G3 at 2 mm (1.335 ns), the best of the remaining candidates, which is a partial fluorinated substitute. This recommendation is conditional on that check.
